spectral_line.reference_contract: The LTE opacity uses the laboratory wavelength; phase-map offsets are added to the HMI tuning reference. The difference is retained and may not be absorbed into the atmospheric velocity zero point.

transmission_model.equation: T(lambda)=(1+B*cos(2*pi*lambda/FSR+Phi+4*phi))/2 for each tunable element; the total response is the element product times the blocking filter
transmission_model.continuum_contract: The response archive integrates throughput outside the inner quadrature window into a continuum weight; LTE uses the mean synthesized Stokes-I edge continuum and zero polarized continuum for this term.

polarization.reference_axis: detector +Y (CCD column-up), derived per acquisition from the FITS WCS pixel-scale matrix
polarization.azimuth_direction: counter-clockwise as viewed from the observer
polarization.contract: The HMI Stokes basis is derived from detector orientation for every acquisition, so CROTA2 is handled by WCS geometry. Stored Q and U are not sign-flipped or rotated in the LTE line operator.
